messages:
asha: Quick question — the pause dedicated pool confirmation modal reads a bit ambiguous to me. Secondary action is 'Cancel' but 'Cancel' could mean cancel the pause or cancel the modal. :thinking_face: matt: yeah i noticed that too when i was testing the flow, users might expect 'Keep running' or 'Don't pause' rather than a generic Cancel. priya: Agreed. Copy should be explicit about the effect. Suggestion: primary = 'Pause pool', secondary = 'Keep pool running' (and keep keyboard ESC mapped to the secondary). ryan: ✋ Small dev note — we wire ESC to close modal today which maps to Cancel. If we rename the button we should still keep the ESC behavior but update aria-label to the new text. asha: Good call. Also, can we avoid negative phrasing like 'Don't pause'? 'Keep pool running' reads clearer. priya: UX nit: if users are skimming, 'Keep pool running' is longer. Maybe 'Keep running' is enough if context shows 'pool'. But in other places we show pool name in the modal header, so shorter might work. matt: Which variant is more accessible? design-bot, any quick a11y checks? design-bot: Automated check: button labels should be clear and describe the action. Prefer verb-first phrasing when possible. Recommendation: use "Keep pool running" for clarity. (a11y rule: avoid ambiguous UI labels for confirmation dialogs). ryan: Implementation question — if we change to "Keep pool running" we should also change the analytics event label to `confirm_modal_secondary` -> `keep_pool_running_clicked` so product can track. asha: Draft copy candidates: 1) Primary: "Pause pool" / Secondary: "Keep pool running" 2) Primary: "Pause pool" / Secondary: "Keep running" 3) Primary: "Pause pool" / Secondary: "Cancel pause" (feels awkward) priya: My vote is #1 for explicitness. #2 is acceptable if modal header includes pool name. matt: I'm leaning #1 too. Also propose microcopy under the heading: "Pausing will cancel in-flight requests and evict workers." gives clarity for the consequence. asha: +1 to adding the one-line consequence. That helps make the confirmation meaningful. ryan: For the code side here's the current snippet we use in the component for reference: ```html
\n

Pause pool?

\n

Pausing will stop new jobs and evict workers.

\n \n \n
``` priya: If we go with #1, update to: ```html ``` asha: Accessibility checklist for the change: update aria-labels, keep ESC behavior, run axe/pa11y on the modal, and update unit tests for analytics event names. matt: I'll own the copy update in the design system. @ryan can you handle the analytics rename? ryan: Yep, I'll add a small migration and a feature flag to roll it out with no gaps. priya: I'll add the updated copy to the modal spec and include the microcopy explaining in-flight request impact. asha: Awesome. Final action items: matt -> update DS button text + spec, ryan -> implement analytics + ESC behavior check, priya -> update modal spec and run accessibility test, asha -> sign off after visual review. :thumbsup: matt: sounds good — i'll push an updated screenshot later today for review. :eyes:
